Author: Elk
Name: Elk's RP Mounts Anywhere
Punchline: Mount anywhere, stay in style — cosmetic RP mounts with Moodles sync.
Description: Turn your favorite mounts into a roleplay accessory, even indoors and in cities. Use familiar FFXIV hotbars, browse mount icons, create macros and share cosmetic mounts with friends through Moodles and compatible sync services. Supports FR/EN and modded appearances. Visual only: no extra speed, flight or movement abilities. Experimental native state modifications; use at your own risk.
